merge_safety.clean_merge: Required initial; ordinary DOLT_MERGE fast-forwards if possible, otherwise clean 3-way merge publishes merge commit unless --no-commit. Upstream assertions in dolt_queries_merge.go:1386-1420; no-commit behavior :805-841.
merge_safety.conflict_target_head: Conflict path does not invoke doDoltCommit; sets conflict working set and returns conflict result. Target HEAD remains pre-merge, but working root may contain non-conflicting merges / partial merge changes. Do not promise unchanged target working data.
merge_safety.autocommit: Default autocommit + dolt_allow_commit_conflicts=0 rolls back unmerged conflict state with ErrUnresolvedConflictsAutoCommit; disable autocommit for manual inspect/commit or explicitly allow commit conflicts to persist diagnostics. See test :1551-1623.
merge_safety.rollback: DoltSession.Rollback clears uncommitted session roots. It cannot undo a clean merge commit already published. Native DOLT_MERGE(--abort) restores an active persisted merge state. No direct rollback-after-conflict test found; implementation requires compatibility probe.
merge_safety.preview_limits: Preview summary reports only data and schema conflict counts, not constraint-violation count. Preview is read-only, but separate from merge and not a transaction-bound plan.
merge_safety.toctou: Preview and merge independently resolve refs; no preview token couples them. Commit publication uses branch locks, expected-head checks and optimistic retry (session.go:699-767; transactions.go:389-485), so the Dolt commit path guards concurrent target updates. Still, preview output can become stale before merge. Re-read/pin source and target hashes and add a compatibility probe for preview-to-merge source/target advancement; verify target does not regress and report diagnostics for the actual resolved pair.
